json.rationale: You are on a paved road (vía pavimentada) meeting an unpaved road at the T-junction. The rule gives right of preference (preferencia de paso) to vehicles on a paved road over those coming from an unpaved one. No other road users are in sight, so you may proceed.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: You must yield because there is a sign on your approach.
json.whyWrong: The visible sign is only classified as 'other', not as a yield or stop sign in the facts, so the excerpts do not create a ceda el paso duty. The only applicable excerpt gives you preference because you are on the paved road.
